# dsh-web-gui-pack 🎨
**DeepSeek Harness Web GUI Customization Pack**
**English** · **简体中文**
## Compatibility

Built for **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** (verified against `0.2.1-rc.2`). The packages declare
`engines.
dsh: ^0.2.1-rc.2`, so a 0.2.x core loads them and narrows/refuses them on 0.1.x.

They do **not** work on 0.1.x: 0.2.1 removed `settingsNamespace` / `installSettingsSection` and
reti

red the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` module. See
docs/ADAPTATION-0.2.1.md for the full breakdow

n (what changed, why,
and how it was verified in a real browser).
## Contents
| Directory | Type | Function |

| `whale-qwq/` | Themes | Settings → General → “Outfits”: Joi·Flowers / Joi·Library  |
| `dsh-custom
-bg/` | Custom Background | Settings → General → “Custom Background”: import a background image and

adjust opacity, with settings saved separately for light and dark modes |
| `dsh-maid-whale-pet/` |
Persistent Mascot | A mascot that follows the sidebar border (tracks drag/resize, shrinks or hides w

hen the gutter is too tight) |
| `dsh-power-button/` | Power Button | Floating "⏻" in the bottom-rig
ht corner: ends the dsh web process after a confirmation (loopback-only route) |
## Installation

Prerequisites: Node.js ≥ 20 and a `dsh` CLI on `PATH` that reports **0.2.x** (`dsh --version`).
No s
ource checkout is needed any more — a 0.2.x plugin is an ordinary npm package.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or run the one-click installation script `install.ps1` (add `-Rebuild` to build the three packages f
the one-click installation script `install.ps1` (add `-Rebuild` to build the three packages first):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
After installation, **restart the Web GUI** — the client module graph is scanned at startup.
## Usage
- **Outfits**: Settings → General → the “Outfits” row → select Joi·Flowers / Joi·Library / DeepSeek

native
- **Background**: Settings → General → “Custom Background” → Import Image → “Enable” → adjust

the opacity
- **Quit**: the floating "⏻" in the bottom-right → confirm → the dsh web process exits;

double-click the desktop icon to start it again
- **Diagnostics**: Run `window.__joi()` (theme) or
`window.__cbg()` (background) in the browser console

from the 0.1.9 bundle with `scripts/recover-baseline.mjs`. `npm run build:full` regenerates both fro

m
`design/` when you do have it.
